name: settings-block
title: Settings block
description: A settings page in sections (profile, account, notifications, appearance, danger zone) on Tabs that turn vertical when the block is wide, with an unsaved changes bar and dialogs to change the email and delete the account, made of the Rabtx components. CSS-only motion.

.rx-settings[data-moved] .rx-settings-pa.transition: opacity 220ms var(--motion-ease) calc(var(--_i) * 60ms), translate var(--spring-panel-duration) var(--spring-panel) calc(var(--_i) * 60ms)

.rx-settings-swatch > span.background: linear-gradient(var(--primary), var(--primary)) 0.5rem 0.5rem / 1.25rem 0.375rem no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--foreground), var(--foreground)) 0.5rem 1.25rem / 60% 0.25rem no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--muted-foreground), var(--muted-foreground)) 0.5rem 1.875rem / 40% 0.25rem no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--muted), var(--muted)) 0.5rem 2.5rem / calc(100% - 1rem) 0.5rem no-repeat, var(--background)

.rx-settings-bar.transition: opacity 160ms var(--motion-ease), translate 160ms var(--motion-ease), scale 160ms var(--motion-ease), border-color 200ms var(--motion-ease), display 160ms allow-discrete

.rx-settings:has(> form[data-dirty]) > ..transition: opacity 200ms var(--motion-ease), translate var(--spring-panel-duration) var(--spring-panel), scale var(--spring-panel-duration) var(--spring-panel), border-color 200ms var(--motion-ease), display var(--spring-panel-duration) allow-discrete
